title: Storage shelves and restocking
summary: Keeping a card shop stocked means somewhere to put things: TCG Card Shop Simulator defines storage shelves, a warehouse shelf and a restocking process with its own screens.
body: Storage is furniture, not a menu: the game defines a storage shelf for cards and a warehouse shelf, each keeping its own saved contents.
Because those contents are saved, what you put away is still there when you come back to it rather than resetting between sessions.
Putting stock back on the sales floor is its own task with its own equipment, including a scanner, so restocking is something you do rather than something that happens.
What this entry does not tell you: how much a storage shelf holds, how many you can place or what the equipment costs. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: There is a storage shelf for cards with saved contents.
There is a warehouse shelf with its own saved contents.
Storage shelves have their own settings screen.
Restocking is a managed process with its own screens and a scanner.
A card storage shelf is a group of its own, and the build names the shelf meshes it can be built from.
